posts.name: Braithwhite
posts.cooked:
Here are a few tips that might help.

1. First round, legacy will be unable to do damage, but can make himself immune to melee. This will spare you some pain with Fright Train, friction, and proletariat.

2. Take out Baron Blade's ongoing ASAP. Constant prattle is annoying, but Ermine is target #1, so she won't be around long. 1st round, you can use Bunker's Locomotion to get rid of it.

3. Let Crushing Hallway stay out the entire game. 

4. Wraith's base power works great against Ermine and Fright Train. Until Ermine goes down, use it and sacrifice equipment from AZ and Wraith in order to keep Bunker's flak cannon out. 

5. Make ABSOLUTELY sure that you have a sacrificial ongoing in play before Ermine's turn if you want to keep things like Heroic interception in play during the Hallway... two sacrificial ongoings if Calypso is out. 

6. Once Ermine goes down (don't be afraid to use an early LSB for 5 damage or so to do it) drop Fright Train. He cranks out a lot of consistent damage, and if you've been using Last Stand on Legacy and Wraith's turn, he'll be close to dead. Don't be afraid to use things like Throat Jabs purely for the extra damage. 

7. Once the Negation Bands come out, chip away at them with Bunker's cannon, but let the Hallway finish them off. Focus on powering down Friction. 

8. I know it's tempting to use the 2nd Heroic interception, but consider waiting a turn. Legacy can do damage to finish off the bands, put down fortitude to tank a bit... it all depends on what you need at that moment. If Everyman's Strength or Fixed Point is out, go for it.

9. Get rid of Everyman's strength ASAP  and defensive measures, if you haven't already.  I prefer stripping him of defenses early on, so that the Hallway can do it's work unhindered.

10. Once Baron Blade is gone, finish off Friction. The constant damage from the Hallway will have everyone low, but hopefully you have more heroes up and running, and the hallways should have crushed her stolen gear by now...

11. Get AZ's equipment set up ASAP once Ermine dies  I'd reccomend getting the focused apertures out first, then modular realigning a null point so that you can tank a bit, then isothermic.  At that point...

12 Proletariat is the last one standing. Gang up on him.

posts.name: robb8888
posts.cooked:
As usual, I've been trying to play a couple of warm-up matches (same heroes/villains/environment) to get used to the combos/strategies....  Geez, this matchup is tough!  I've played about 5 warm-ups, and lost every single one.  What you need against this group of villains is damage, LOTS of it, and quickly.  Unfortunately, this group of heroes takes so long to get set up and going, and with Ermine taking out 1-2 cards a turn, I can never get anything going soon enough to avoid getting slaughtered.  I try to take out Ermine first, but since everyone is SO dependent upon loads of equipment/ongoings to do consistent damage, I can never keep anything in play long enough to be able to beat up on her -- it usually takes me 3-4 rounds to be able to knock her out.  By that time, all of my heroes are down to single digits (or close to it), and the villains are all still in the high teens/20s.  

 

I think I'd prefer this matchup with the *NON*-Freedom Six versions of the heroes; Legacy could instantly buff everyone instead of waiting for Inspiring Presence, AZ could begin healing himself almost right away while he waits to get his combos in play, and Wraith could use her base power to avoid getting creamed.

 

[UPDATE:  Tried the actual one-shot, and Minted it.  I think this is one of the rare one-shots where the actual game is easier than the practice rounds.  The Fueled Freeze was a godsend, Blade never got out the Implosion Beam (which makes Tachyon almost useless, and makes it nearly impossible to keep up with all of the Ongoing/Equipment destruction), and Surprise Shopping Trip never came up.] 

[2ND UPDATE:  I was so P.O.ed at this villain setup that I put together a special team to give them a beat-down:   Regular Legacy, Scholar, Ra, SkyScraper, and Regular Wraith.  Even on Advanced, it wasn't a challenge:   Drawn to the Flame and Legacy's buffs meant 4+ AOE damage every round, and between Scholar's card draw and SkyScraper's throwing out Links as destruction bait Ermine didn't do much.  Ended with 17, 25, 23, 15, and 19]

posts.name: Melkhor
posts.cooked: You'd miss the regular damage pumped out by AZ and the Wraith, then, not to mention the card draw of Tachyon and at several points of this match, Bunker's ability to reliably get rid of Ongoings is an absolute necessity too ;)
